# Release notes

## Steps

1. List the pull requests merged since the previous tag (CORE-WORK-01). Check: each has a number and a title.
2. Group them under Breaking changes, Added, Changed and Fixed, in that order (CORE-SKILL-05). Check: every pull request is in one group, and each removed or incompatible endpoint is under Breaking changes.
3. Write `docs/releases/<version>.md`. Check: the file names the version and its date.
